paragraphs.text: A free sample raises sales of a product for a week, and shops have used them for a century. Coffee, cheese and shampoo are the commonest items on the table.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Most of the effect disappears quickly. Customers who bought after tasting rarely buy a second time unless the price is also lower, and a month later sales are back where they started.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Waste is the hidden cost. Samples are prepared in advance and thrown away at closing time, and one chain calculated that a fifth of everything opened for tasting went into the bin.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Some shops now give a sample only to a customer who asks, which halves the amount used and, according to the same chain, keeps almost all of the extra sales.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: shops have used them for a century

explanation.en: An old selling trick and the usual items → i.
explanation.kk: Саудадағы ескі тәсіл және оның заттары → i.
explanation.ru: Старый приём торговли и его предметы → i.

items.quote: Most of the effect disappears quickly.

explanation.en: The effect does not last → ii.

items.quote: a fifth of everything opened for tasting went into the bin

explanation.en: The hidden cost is what goes in the bin → iii.

items.quote: give a sample only to a customer who asks
keywords: only to a customer who asks

explanation.en: A smaller version: a sample only on request → iv.
explanation.kk: Кішірейтілген нұсқа: үлгі тек сұрағанға → iv.
explanation.ru: Уменьшенный вариант: образец только по просьбе → iv.
